errors.text: The orientation mechanism is misstated: the higher axial yield stress along <-111> is associated with less favorable resolved shear geometry and therefore a larger applied stress needed to reach the CRSS, not more favorable shear alignment.
The hypothesis inconsistently claims that local inhomogeneity both lowers and raises the dislocation-nucleation barrier.
The cited studies do not directly establish vacancy-cluster or solute-cluster nucleation in the simulated FCC FeNiCrMn system.
